composition.note: seats won in the Nov. 8, 2022 general election (Louisiana: Nov. 8 open primary)

pctNote: dPct/rPct = combined share of all Democratic (incl. DFL, fusion lines) / Republican candidates over votes for named candidates (unnamed scattering/blank/void rows excluded); uncontested = no opponent other than write-ins.
flipNote: flip compares the 2022 winner with the party that last held the same numbered district (2020 general, or a 2021-22 special held before Nov. 2022); because of 2020-census redistricting this is approximate and differs from the conventional seat-change count.
